founder.subtitle: About Founder
founder.name: CA Sarika S Chordiya
paras: The firm was founded and is led by CA Sarika S. Chordiya (FCA, MBA, Psych.), a seasoned Chartered Accountant with more than 25 years of professional experience in taxation, regulatory representation, and financial advisory.

Her professional practice focuses on complex tax matters, regulatory proceedings, and strategic financial advisory for businesses and professionals across diverse industries. In addition to leading the firm's professional engagements, she has been actively associated with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, contributing to professional initiatives and activities within the Chartered Accountancy community.

She has also conducted several professional sessions and awareness programs on VAT, GST in coordination with Government departmental authorities, contributing to knowledge dissemination and professional education within the business and professional community.

Under her leadership, S. S. Chordiya & Co. has served more than 2,500 clients across sectors including manufacturing, infrastructure, real estate, trading, professional services, and emerging enterprises. The firm's practice is defined by technical rigor, regulatory discipline, and a structured advisory approach aimed at supporting clients in navigating complex financial and regulatory environments while enabling sustainable long-term growth.
